# Research question

When do thermodynamic and interphase-model choices change predicted capture and
axial temperature, and which numerical methods resolve those changes efficiently?
The submitted revision is preserved separately. This notebook organizes retained
findings, numerical preservation checks and possible next studies.

# Select the calculation explicitly

One TOML or JSON file declares a single case, physical model choices, numerical method,
initialization and execution settings. Its immutable selection is resolved by
`resolve_column_config` and executed by `run_column`. Direct-script preview
prints it without importing thermodynamics or a solver; execution requires
`--run` and a new output directory.

Python callers pass the same mapping to `run_column` and receive the JSON-safe
attempt that is retained in `attempt.json`. The command accepts JSON requests
through the same resolver. Execution prints one attempt JSON to stdout, with
Python solver messages on stderr. Its exit code distinguishes completed
execution (0), a returned failed/timed-out/interrupted attempt (1), and a separate
load, request or overwrite error (2). Each result's numerical, physical and
scientific acceptance retains its own meaning. This is a configured calculation
for a caller; no graphical app or server is required.

```bash
python3 src/mea_absorption_column/research.py --list-options
python3 src/mea_absorption_column/research.py analyses/research_options/options.toml
uv run --no-sync python src/mea_absorption_column/research.py case.json --run > attempt.json
```

| Preset | Selectable calculations | Present limits |
|---|---|---|
| `seven_state_legacy` | Henry, neutral/ionic or nine-species ePC-SAFT; enhancement or supplied frozen film; shooting, SciPy BVP or finite differences; temperature or empirical enthalpy states | Current Engine pin lacks interfaces required by the old ePC-SAFT adapters; selected unavailable calculations retain the cause before the outer solve |
| `twelve_state_conserved` | Reactive ePC-SAFT, equilibrium-manifold or enhancement-reference film; trapezoidal, centered or upwind differences | Existing fixed case policy and exploratory physical limits; reduced shooting/collocation remain unavailable |

Physical overrides belong in `model.parameters`; numerical resolution and state
representation belong in `numerics.solver_settings`. Coupled chemistry follows
the selected thermodynamics, and conflicting declarations are refused. A frozen
film remains an outer-iteration input. Each native numerical owner retains its
existing compatibility checks, returned grid, equations and failures. The
low-level `research.run_conserved` utility remains available for already
constructed numerical equations, outside ordinary TOML column execution.
For seven-state multistart requests, the existing worker launcher applies process
isolation and the wall limit separately to each candidate; the parent selects
among their retained records. One candidate's wall limit is not a total deadline
for that parent calculation.

# Configuration preservation

The consolidated command reproduces the direct Henry calculation for
`C_cases_data/3C` on the same converted feeds and prepared Engine wheel. This is
numerical verification of configuration transport and execution, with unchanged
column equations. It does not validate the physical prediction or establish a
speed improvement.

The reference uses molar input conversion, `legacy_ratio` vapor composition,
`reported_total_wet` gas flow, one bed, explicit enhancement, empirical enthalpy
states, raw transformation and a numerical Jacobian. The SciPy boundary-value
method starts with 21 nodes, tolerance 0.5, boundary tolerance 0.001 and a
1000-node limit. The final command uses an isolated worker with a 120 s wall
limit. Its native normalized-height grid contains 22 nodes; outer solution
terminates after two iterations. Feed conversion and physical-input fingerprints
agree exactly.

| Quantity | Direct reference | Consolidated command | Absolute difference |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Capture, percent of specified inlet vapor CO2 | 91.4830870059853 | 91.4830870059853 | 0 percentage points |
| Boundary percentage-norm | 6.69501755457092e-14 | 6.69501755457092e-14 | 0 |
| Maximum difference in scaled native states | — | — | 0 |
| Maximum difference in sampled liquid/vapor temperature | — | — | 0 K |

The native grid, state layout and solver-stage termination also agree exactly.
The checks require capture difference at most `1e-8` percentage points, scaled
states within `rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-12`, and sampled temperatures within `1e-8 K`.
Two direct repeats were identical. These tolerances protect numerical
preservation on this case; they make no physical-accuracy statement. The table
is sufficient because the question is exact preservation of one calculation;
overlaying identical profiles would add no distinction.

An isolated request for the existing nine-species seven-state adapter retains
`ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'epcsaft.records'` before the outer solver.
It contains no outer solver stages, computed capture or temperature values, or
native profile. Numerical and physical acceptance remain unevaluated. The
prepared wheel lacks the retired interface used by that adapter; replacing the
adapter is a separate thermodynamic integration change. This finding identifies
an execution boundary and says nothing about whether the physical equations
have a solution. The twelve-state formulation retains its separate numerical
owners and fixed input policy; no new twelve-state column calculation is claimed.

Exact values and identities are retained in
[the reference](results/configuration/henry_reference.json),
[the final command attempt](results/configuration/henry_candidate_final/attempt.json),
[the unavailable attempt](results/configuration/reactive_nine_unavailable_final/attempt.json)
and [their comparison](results/configuration/comparison.json). The wheel SHA-256
is `48a639e78d00ef88a2f7e66ed1e3d89831ca0ad5267322330d44f48c34926060`,
from Engine commit `464a9897615e513e5cc404ce5b49f46a72466d3d`.
The retained values have not been promoted for manuscript use.

# Python and JSON calling verification

The same Henry reference also verifies the two calling paths on its stated
feed basis and numerical settings. Before the return change, the configured
in-process calculation returned 91.4830870059853 percent capture and 22 nodes,
but standard JSON encoding failed because its return contained a NumPy array.
Its saved attempt already used the existing array and tabulated-profile
representation. The public return now uses that same representation.

| Calling path | Capture, percent | Maximum scaled-state difference from reference | Maximum sampled-temperature difference |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Python configured call | 91.4830870059853 | 0 | 0 K |
| JSON-file command | 91.4830870059853 | 0 | 0 K |

Both paths preserve the exact 22-node native grid, state layout, solver-stage
termination and converted-feed fingerprint. Strict JSON encoding succeeds, and
each returned attempt equals its own retained `attempt.json`. The command was
also exercised with Python solver messages enabled: its complete stdout parses
as one JSON object while those messages appear on stderr. These are numerical
and calling-behavior checks, not physical validation or a speed comparison;
the existing scalar preservation table is sufficient for this equality question.

The completed command returned exit 0. A nine-species seven-state request
returned exit 1 and the precise missing `epcsaft.records` cause, with no outer
solver stages, computed capture or native profile. A repeated request to the
existing output directory returned exit 2 with `FileExistsError` and left the
retained attempt unchanged. Exit codes describe execution or request handling;
numerical, physical and scientific acceptance remain separate returned fields.
The malformed request `numerics.method=[]` also returns exit 2 with the original
`TypeError: unhashable type: 'list'` before any model calculation. This error
handling applies to request loading and resolution; execution defects retain
their separate meaning.
Python stdout redirection does not promise capture of arbitrary future native
library writes. The prepared interpreter and wheel requirements still apply.

The [calling comparison](results/configuration/call_comparison.json) links the
exact requests, numerical attempts and diagnostic output. The
[pre-change encoding failure](results/configuration/python_return_before/encoding.json),
[Python attempt](results/configuration/python_return_after_final/attempt.json),
[JSON-command attempt](results/configuration/json_command_return_final/attempt.json)
and [unavailable request](results/configuration/json_command_unavailable_final/attempt.json)
retain their own source and input identities. This evidence supports calling
the existing configured calculation from a host application without another
numerical implementation. It adds no availability or accuracy claim for other
thermodynamic selections and has not been promoted for manuscript use.

| MDEA and eNRTL | MDEA interface groundwork is retained, but neither is an integrated selectable column model here | Supply equations, parameter/reaction bases and mapped observations before claiming a comparable model |

# Comparison design

Change one specified closure at a time when interpreting its effect. Compare
common feed bases, geometry, transport assumptions and reaction definitions;
then investigate their interactions explicitly. Keep numerical residuals,
conservation, profile refinement, observed agreement and runtime scope separate.
A model may converge and still disagree with observations. A timeout is a measured
budget outcome, not evidence that the physical equations have no solution.

# Working practice

Create a study configuration, run it separately into a new directory, inspect its
results and failures, then update an analysis notebook. Render with execution
disabled. Candidate promotions should state the scientific question, exact inputs,
method, checks, uncertainty and what remains unexplained. Manuscript editing is
outside this research phase.
